falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days, the S&P 500 closes at least 3.0% above its verdict-date close and at a new 63-trading-day high, on a session when the VIX closes at or below 14.0.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The tape resolved to a confirmed upside continuation, so the June 2019 mini-top analogue failed and both UNKNOWN and HOLD were the wrong call; the correct signal was risk-on.

falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days, the S&P 500 closes at least 5.0% below its verdict-date close on a session when the VIX closes at or above 25.0.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Phase resolved into a volatility shock rather than an unknowable hold or a mild mini-top, so HOLD was wrong and the 77% mini_top_2019_jun match did not describe the regime.

falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days, the share of S&P 500 stocks above their 50-day moving average rises by at least 12 percentage points from the verdict-date reading and ICE BofA US High Yield OAS tightens by at least 40 basis points from the verdict-date level.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Broadening participation plus a credit bid contradict a developing mini-top and a moderate blowoff (score 56), so the pattern match and the UNKNOWN verdict are invalidated even if the index itself has not broken out.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
